The organization's evaluation highlights several limiting factors, starting with <cite id="2">a program expense ratio of 74.1%</cite> in FY2024, which falls slightly below the 75% standard sector benchmark. Additionally, financial metrics show <cite id="1">excessive working capital reserves holding 41.7 months of working capital</cite>, meaning significant donor capital remains sitting in reserve rather than actively funding direct services. On the operational side, the charity recorded <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $33,643,969 in FY2024</cite>, down from $42,317,102 in FY2022, reflecting revenue contraction over a three-year period. Despite these factors, the organization maintains <cite id="1">a 100/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> and operates with low fundraising overhead, spending only <cite id="1">$0.13 per $1 raised</cite>.
